answer: Agents prove unique physical presence by modulating a pigment-tagged optical beacon whose phase drift, like sand shifting across a dune, is tracked against an autonomous ephemeris that no clone can predict. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
